scope: All unique fine-resolution Parkes S/R HDF5 products for HIP47103 returned by official public archive query, including prior observations, partitioned deterministically into eight shards. Maximum 128 files; if exceeded record HOLD rather than silently sample. Freeze exact URL list before power access.
models: Unchanged R12 fixed original drift, fixed zero drift, same-session linear extrapolation, constant barycentric frequency. Reverse line tested separately. Same matched score>=8 and persistence>=0.5. No candidate promotion.
morphology: For every original-day scan take entire 1 MHz window; preserve full time rows, frequency grid, SHA256, median spectrum and scan maxima; list stationary peaks (all local maxima with >=8/16 rows >3 relative noise, separated 28 Hz; retain strongest 100, report total and cap). Compare frequency match +/- 3 channels, relative offsets, on/off profiles. Descriptive not proof shared emitter.
sensitivity: In each matched candidate window inject one-channel track at deterministic +/- 70 channel offsets, at 4 and 8 per-row robust noise units; matched search, not blind calibration; no thresholds changed.

external.query: Public BL query-files API: target HIP47103, HIP47103_S, HIP47103_R; all instruments and named GBT/MeerKAT/ATA; record returned telescope names, products and center frequencies, no claim coverage from center alone. Review facilities via official pages. Prepare unsent technical request; no telescope booking or permission implied.

claims: Same-session recovery is not independent replication. No evidence of extraterrestrial origin. Separate-day archive data absence only constrains tested emission models and sensitivity.
